title: Geometric regularity of one fibre descends from maximal target localizations
statement: Let R and S be commutative rings, with S an R-algebra and Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Fix a prime ideal p of R and its residue field kappa(p) [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. If for every maximal ideal m of S the fibre kappa(p) tensor_R S_m is geometrically regular over kappa(p) [def-weil-pbc-g-ring], then kappa(p) tensor_R S is geometrically regular over kappa(p). No flatness hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Lemma Tag 07C0 (lemma-regular-local), fibre argument in (3) implies (1); checked at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07C0 on 2026-10-12

proof.text: The fibre F = kappa(p) tensor_R S is Noetherian by the Noetherian fibre theorem. A finite purely inseparable extension K/kappa(p) gives an extended fibre F_K finite over F, hence of finite type and Noetherian.

Fix a prime n of F_K and contract it to a prime q of S. Choose a maximal ideal m containing q. For each s outside m its image is outside n, since s is outside q. Tensor products commute with localization: K tensor_kappa(p) (kappa(p) tensor_R S_m) is the localization of F_K at the images of S minus m. By the hypothesis and geometric regularity, this ring is regular.

Because n avoids these denominators, (F_K)_n is a localization at a prime of the regular ring just obtained, and hence regular local. The Noetherian regular-ring local criterion proves F_K regular. Apply the definition of geometric regularity to all finite purely inseparable K to conclude. If S is zero, F and all F_K are zero, whose regularity follows because they have no primes.

proof_origin.note: Expanded the fibre part of the proof of Stacks 07C0, keeping the base prime fixed and separating it from flatness and source localization.

theorem isGeometricallyRegular_fiber_of_localizations_maximal
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [IsNoetherianRing S] (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime]
    (h : ∀ (m : Ideal S) [m.IsMaximal],
      IsGeometricallyRegular p.ResidueField (p.Fiber (Localization.AtPrime m))) :
    IsGeometricallyRegular p.ResidueField (p.Fiber S)
